title: Field boundaries for Romania - Eurocrops
description:
The dataset includes the land cover layer from the Romanian side of the Romania-Bulgaria cross-border area (Mehedinți, Dolj, Olt, Teleorman, Giurgiu, Călărași, Constanța counties), developed within the project "Common strategy for territorial development of the cross-border area Romania-Bulgaria", code MIS-ETC 171, funded by the Romania-Bulgaria Cross-Border Cooperation Programme 2007-2013.

The dataset is published in the WGS 84 / UTM zone 35N coordinate system (to be compatible with the similar dataset on the Bulgarian side).

The dataset is in line with the conceptual framework described in the Land Cover Data Specifications for the Implementation of the INSPIRE Directive (version 3.0). The information layer was developed based on a methodology developed within the project, which was carried out as follows: - analysis and harmonisation of the land cover classification system; - acquisition and processing of the reference data, listed below; - verification and validation of the quality of the spatial data produced;

This collection holds 1 edition (2026), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2026). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:32635). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_ro/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are declared: they come from farmers' subsidy applications, or from the parcel register built on those declarations.

providers.name: Ministry of Regional Development and Public Administration

table:columns.name: hcat:name
table:columns.description: The machine-readable HCAT name of the crop (Hierarchical Crop and Agriculture Taxonomy, EuroCrops). ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:code
table:columns.description: The 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop. The first 4, 6, 8 digits select increasingly specific crop groups. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: hcat:name_en
table:columns.description: The original crop name translated into English. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/hcat-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: crop:code
table:columns.description: The crop code, from the code list of the source. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: source
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `SOURCE`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: crop:name
table:columns.description: Crop name in the original language. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/crop-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Romania - Eurocrops — latest edition (2026) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2026/ec_ro-2026.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-hcat-crops.title: Crops (HCAT)
style-hcat-crops.description: Fields coloured by harmonized crop (EuroCrops HCAT code, `hcat:code`). The 5 crops covering the most area are named, everything else is grey. Colours follow the fiboa.org crop map palette.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 1, 5, 10, 20 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
